This commit adds SSH-based direct datastore access as an alternative

- Add client.rs: Unified DatastoreClient enum wrapping HTTP and SSH
- Update fs.rs: Use DatastoreClient instead of direct EsxiClient
- Update main.rs: Add --use-ssh and --ssh-connections flags

Usage:
  --use-ssh                   Enable SSH+dd streaming mode
  --ssh-connections=COUNT     Number of concurrent SSH connections (default: 16)

Benefits over HTTP:
- Bypasses ESXi HTTP API rate limiting
- Direct datastore access via dd
- Potentially 2-4x faster on some systems
- Lower protocol overhead

Requires SSH key authentication to ESXi host.
